text: Junior Machine Learning Intern at TechVision AI. 3-month remote program, 20 hours per week. Interns work on real ML projects with weekly mentorship from senior engineers and receive a completion certificate. Monthly stipend of 8,000 EGP. Requirements: basic Python and basic ML knowledge. Apply through careers@techvision.ai after a short technical interview. Possibility of full-time offer based on performance.

Backend Developer Intern, Nile Software (registered company, website nilesoftware.com). 4 months, hybrid (3 days on site in Cairo), 25 hours per week, paid 6,000 EGP per month. You will build REST APIs with FastAPI under a dedicated mentor, take part in code reviews, and present your work at the end. Requirements: Python, basic SQL, Git. Hiring process: CV, 30 minute interview, small take-home task. Certificate and reference letter provided.

Data Analyst Trainee at a bank's analytics department. 6 months, paid, 30 hours per week, on site. Structured training plan in SQL, Power BI and statistics, an assigned supervisor, and a final project presented to management. Requirements: final-year student in CS, statistics or engineering. Apply via the official bank careers portal. Conversion to full-time for top performers.

AI Research Intern, university-affiliated lab. 3 months, remote, 15 hours per week, stipend 5,000 EGP per month. Work on NLP experiments with a PhD supervisor, weekly meetings, and a chance to co-author a workshop paper. Requirements: Python, PyTorch basics, interest in NLP. Application by email to the lab director with CV and transcript, followed by an interview.

Junior Data Analyst Intern at a small startup. 3 months, remote. Pay is not specified. You will help the team with dashboards and reports. Requirements: Excel and basic SQL. Send your CV to the founder's email. Hours and mentorship are not described.

Software Engineering Intern, 40 hours per week on site, 3 months, paid 2,000 EGP per month. Work on the company's internal tools. Requirements: knowledge of Java or Python. No mention of mentorship or training. Apply on the company website. Certificate on completion.

Digital Marketing Intern. Unpaid, 3 months, remote, 10 hours per week. You will learn SEO and social media from the marketing lead and receive a certificate and a recommendation letter. Company is a small agency with an active portfolio website. Requirements: good English and social media familiarity.

Machine Learning Intern wanted. Duration and pay to be discussed. The company works on AI solutions for clients. You will join an active team and learn on the job. Requirements: Python, TensorFlow, 1 year of experience. Contact us on LinkedIn to apply.

URGENT!!! Data Entry Assistant needed. Earn $5000 per week from home! No experience needed. No interview. Guaranteed job. To start, send a copy of your national ID, your bank account number and a registration fee of $50 to our WhatsApp. Limited spots, reply today!
Marketing Intern wanted. Full-time, 9 AM to 6 PM, 6 days a week. Unpaid. Responsibilities will be explained later. Possibility of employment after completion. Must have 3 years of experience.

Work from home and earn 300 dollars per day by processing online orders. Pay a refundable training deposit of 100 dollars to activate your account. We will send you a cheque to deposit and you forward part of it to our supplier. Message us on Telegram now, no CV needed, immediate start.

Looking for interns for our exciting company. 12 hours a day, no breaks, no pay, no contract. You must bring your own laptop and pay 2,000 EGP for the uniform and materials. Duties include whatever management asks. Applications are accepted only through a personal WhatsApp number.
